@Higgsfield

/katana Recreate this aura edit using my subject. Match the reference’s pacing, camera movement, transitions, color grade, and graphic effects, and adapt the scenes and on-screen text to my subject. Keep the reference soundtrack unless I request a different track. Ask me for the reference video and a photo or clip of my subject before starting.

Reference media:
- [Reference 1](https://static.higgsfield.ai/landing/gpt-skills/katana/20261017-inputs/subject-reference.webp)
- [Reference 2](https://static.higgsfield.ai/landing/gpt-skills/katana/20261017-inputs/style-reference.webp)

If the Higgsfield plugin is not installed, ask me to [install the Higgsfield plugin](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/higgsfield?open_in_app) before continuing.
